closure_rule: Any changed anchor, node row, discovered consumer, or consumer-set membership invalidates finality and requires source-graph regeneration plus a fresh successor closure and independent review. external_identity_rule: External provider binary identities remain exact historical data inside the pinned execution-window closure; this design verifier does not open, execute, rehash, or write those external paths.
